claim: All 193 supplied logs are accessible, including five recovered from Epoch; every one of 19,500 attempts has the same FEN and target as the 100-item reconstruction. Candidate and extraction prompt templates each remain constant.

evidence.location: all records; no dataset mismatches; one candidate and extraction prompt

reproduce: Run evidence/analyze_logs.py. Public recovery URLs are in the repository audit/logs.csv; selected primary data are in evidence/log_primary_excerpts.json.
limitations: The public task is reconstructed rather than the complete private implementation; provider defaults remain defaults and hidden reasoning cannot be read.

claim: Stockfish 17.1 independently ranked the stored reference first on all 100 positions at depth 20 with three candidate lines; all positions and reference moves are legal.
reproduce: Install stockfish and chess, then run evidence/engine_scan.py.
limitations: Finite engine search is not a proof of chess-theoretic uniqueness; close choices need deeper checks.

claim: Published high-reasoning configurations often terminate at their output limit without a final answer; reasonable lower-effort or reserved-answer-budget configurations of the same models complete more answers and score higher.

evidence.location: Sonnet 4.6 max/high/medium, Opus 4.7 max/low, Qwen 3.5 9B thinking/none
Sonnet4.6 3/100 versus13/100; Opus4.7 7/100 versus20/100; Qwen3.5 9B2/100 versus12/100; exact request settings and stops
published rows linked by Epoch log ID

reproduce: Compare matched model runs using prompt/target identity, generation settings, max_tokens stop reasons and final text.
limitations: Effort settings and some API versions differ as well as token allocation. Do not interpret raw score differences as a controlled estimate of the cap alone.

claim: Puzzle86 has one verified historical false negative: Qwen3.5 397B A17B none gave the requested correct final move g8e6; the grader retained MOVE: in its extracted string and exact matching rejected it. This one correction raises that run from13/100 to14/100.

evidence.location: completion, score and raw grader submission

reproduce: Run evidence/verify_historical86.py; compare the candidate final MOVE line, reference, and grader tool arguments.
limitations: A single observed attempt error, not evidence that all completions on this puzzle or all puzzles fail. Ordinary mini-low replay probes succeed; they do not erase the recorded mini-medium failure.

claim: Version1.1.6 contains105 logs graded by GPT5mini and51 by GPT5.6Terra, all published in the same data table. This is an unversioned grading-procedure change. Across225 naturally repeated nonempty answer texts on the same puzzles evaluated under multiple grader models, no correctness disagreement was found.

evidence.location: 324 groups including99 blank;225 nonempty groups; no correctness disagreements
all156 new supplied logs matched by published ID

reproduce: Run evidence/compare_logs.py. Group exact visible completion hashes by puzzle and reference, then compare grades across graders.
limitations: This observational overlap is biased toward short repeated responses; it cannot certify all graders equivalent on long explanations. Material score incomparability is not established.

claim: All193 supplied logs use the same candidate prompt, reference set and no candidate tools. Reasoning modes and output budgets vary by model, but no separate material advantage from a privileged scaffold is established.

evidence.location: actual request settings and sample transcripts

reproduce: Compare prompt and tool counters, model generation configurations and actual API settings across every run.
limitations: Different model-specific limits need not have equal effects; resource-linked completion failures are established separately under elicitation. No equal-compute causal experiment was run.

claim: Final whole-population item assessment resolves all100 puzzles:99 have no demonstrated issue and puzzle86 has a historical false-negative defect. All six requested checks are completed for each selected assessment.

evidence.location: selected original auditor logs and adjudication provenance
426 ordinary scoring probes across121 initial/followup audits covering100 distinct puzzles

reproduce: Run evidence/read_audits.py, audit_probes.py and export_final_coverage.py. Superseded labels are retained in the original logs and audit_results.json.
